FX-DEPTH-001.says: Pass Extract as added: the depth, Black Point 0, White Point 1, Clamp on: every depth past 1 is white, the nearest pixel (0.5) mid grey; the picture is opaque, its clear corner too.

FX-DEPTH-002.says: Black 0, White 12: the depth as a grey ramp, near dark, far light.

FX-DEPTH-003.says: Black 12, White 0: the other way round, near light.

FX-DEPTH-004.says: Black 0, White 12, Invert on: FX-DEPTH-002 turned over, as 003.

FX-DEPTH-005.says: Black 10, White 14, Clamp off, the other names' file (depth 1 to 20): values below 0 and above 1 are kept.

FX-DEPTH-006.says: Black and White both 6: a cut, white from depth 6 on, black nearer; the pixel exactly at 6 is white.

FX-DEPTH-007.says: The normals, Black -1, White 1: each direction as a colour, x red, y green, z blue, mid grey for 0.

FX-DEPTH-008.says: The normals as added, Black 0, White 1, Clamp on: what points left or down is held at 0.

FX-DEPTH-009.says: The data window only columns 2 to 6 of rows 1 to 4: outside it the depth is 0, black, as the colour there is clear.

FX-DEPTH-011.says: Normals named normal.R, normal.G, normal.B: found.

FX-DEPTH-012.says: Infinities and not-a-number in the depth: far infinity white, near infinity black, not-a-number read as 0, black; the warning every frame.

FX-DEPTH-013.says: A file with no depth: nothing changes, with the warning every frame.

FX-DEPTH-014.says: Asked for normals from a file with depth only: nothing changes, the warning.

FX-DEPTH-015.says: On a PNG drawing: no passes, nothing changes, the warning.

FX-DEPTH-016.says: On a solid: no file, nothing changes, the warning.

FX-DEPTH-017.says: On an adjustment layer above the EXR: no file of its own, nothing changes, the warning.

FX-DEPTH-018.says: An Exposure of +1 before it is not seen: FX-DEPTH-002.

FX-DEPTH-019.says: An Exposure of -1 after it darkens the ramp.

FX-DEPTH-020.says: The layer moved 2 right and 1 down: FX-DEPTH-002 moved.

FX-DEPTH-021.says: White Point keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 12 at frame 4: frame 0 is FX-DEPTH-001, frame 4 FX-DEPTH-002.

FX-DEPTH-022.says: Depth Key as added: Depth 0, no feather: every depth is at least 0, so nothing changes.

FX-DEPTH-023.says: Depth 6: everything nearer than 6 taken out; the pixel exactly at 6 kept.

FX-DEPTH-024.says: Depth 6, Invert on: everything from 6 on taken out instead.

FX-DEPTH-025.says: Depth 6, Feather 4: a soft edge from 4 to 8.

FX-DEPTH-026.says: Depth 6, Feather 4, Invert on: the soft edge the other way.

FX-DEPTH-027.says: Depth 6 on the file with infinities: far infinity kept, near infinity and not-a-number (0) out; the warning.

FX-DEPTH-028.says: Depth 5 on the small data window: inside it the near pixels go; outside it the depth is 0, out, but already clear.

FX-DEPTH-029.says: An Exposure of +1 before it: the kept pixels are the brighter ones.

FX-DEPTH-030.says: Depth Key on a file with no depth: nothing changes, the warning.

FX-DEPTH-031.says: Depth keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 12.5 at frame 4: frame 4 has only the far corner left.

FX-DEPTH-032.says: Pass Extract's pass written "uv". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DEPTH-033.says: Pass Extract's clamp written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DEPTH-034.says: Black Point 2,000,000, past 1,000,000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DEPTH-035.says: Depth Key's feather -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DEPTH-036.says: Depth Key's invert written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
